name: StaffSinger
cover:
You can sing it.
Can you write
it down?

features.label: The usual way
features.headline:
Hunting notes
key by key
features.text:
The melody is in your head.
Getting it onto the staff takes forever.

features.label: Just say it
features.headline:
Say do re mi,
get real notes
features.text:
After four metronome beats, say the
note names. They land on the staff.

features.label: On the beat
features.headline:
Speak in time,
the rhythm comes too
features.text:
Snap to 1/4, 1/8 or 1/16 notes.
Or keep it free and fix lengths later.

features.label: Bonus
features.headline:
Hear it back
right away
features.text:
Press play for a count-in and a click.
The note that's sounding lights up.

outro:
Stop hunting keys.
Just say the notes
